**ACCEPT — HC-01–05 and the finite implementation/qualification plan at Engine `67f3d201b202ab2f815ab69940682f04e78c511c` are agreed for implementation.** I found no remaining concrete preimplementation design blocker in this review.

This verdict applies to the [complete HC packet](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/67f3d201b202ab2f815ab69940682f04e78c511c/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-23-int05-admitted-command-surface/FULL_HC_REVIEW_PACKET.md), interpreted through its [explicit decision precedence](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/67f3d201b202ab2f815ab69940682f04e78c511c/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-23-int05-admitted-command-surface/CONTRACT_DECISION_ORDER.json). Earlier retained proposal/open labels do not override the later concrete dispositions.

| Gate | Accepted design boundary |
|---|---|
| **HC-01** | Additive V1 coverage across the 24 selected factories, 78 seat-command candidates and two operator kinds. Existing signatures, grants, native rules, fingerprints, saves and legacy response semantics remain unchanged. |
| **HC-02** | Shared pure guard extraction; owning checkpoint comparison; narrowly scoped condition materialization at trusted publication boundaries; explicit current read context. No read-time resolver, replay, RNG reconstruction, reservation, candidate validation, lifecycle fold, settlement or proof repair. Actual execution and projection-failure isolation retain their specified boundaries. |
| **HC-03** | The 204 semantic axes, 145 example variants, typed domains, actual pending choices and deterministic example construction are sufficiently specified. Examples remain illustrative candidates, with native assessment and current authority governing admission. |
| **HC-04** | The effective field rights, causal joins, temporal meanings, scalar/List representations, dimensions, sentinels and five-unit bindings are agreed. The exact **30 diagnostic codes and eight stages** are accepted with their origin-specific predicates and effective corrections. |
| **HC-05** | Effective submission grants, observation freshness, original command revision ordering, current authority before successful duplicate recognition, separate detail authorization, automatic-controller provenance and typed/console parity are agreed. |

The [diagnostic contract](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/67f3d201b202ab2f815ab69940682f04e78c511c/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-23-int05-admitted-command-surface/SAFE_DIAGNOSTIC_CONTRACT_PROPOSAL.md) adequately distinguishes protected gameplay constraints, technical projection failures, actual rejected attempts and committed contact stops. In particular:

- Exact originating branch plus selected operation/variant/profile controls the mapping—not a token alone.
- The seven explicit overrides and later exact-origin refinements control their specified bindings.
- Missing required mappings remain qualification defects. `RequestUnavailable` is permitted only for deliberately reviewed protected mappings.
- Independent authorized costs, domains, prerequisites and alternatives remain required.
- New detail privacy does not rewrite or claim to sanitize the embedded legacy result.
- Per-call origin capture cannot become exception-text inference, ambient failure state or another resolver invocation.

The qualification allocation is also agreed: the complete 244-command principal route at 28 checkpoints; five complete execution modes; separately allocated incompatible branches; all 24 factory entries; and 22 authentic 95–116 inputs under their original policies. FishingTrap95 and work-control116 require their own inputs despite shared wire versions.

**The following remain implementation proof obligations, not missing design decisions:**

- Demonstrate transitive read purity through both unchanged state and prohibited-call instrumentation.
- Demonstrate actual once-only execution, native guard order, rollback, current authority/privacy, retries and truthful projection failure handling.
- Execute the prospective genuine routes, including Strain recovery and the expressly required pending-choice branches. Model or detached controls cannot silently replace those witnesses.
- Complete persistence, backup, forgery, console and five-path comparisons on one frozen candidate.
- Reconcile all **1,601 predecessor names plus meaningful new cases**, retaining raw failures and actual exits. The previous I/O disposition grants no new waiver.

If implementation exposes an additional reachable origin, changed native semantics or a blocked required genuine route, retain the finding and obtain its precise disposition. This acceptance grants no automatic allocation for such a finding.

My actual review covered the governing contracts, effective decisions, extraction and qualification plans, diagnostic policy and targeted native-source joins. I independently checked agreement of all **80 operation kinds and 204 axes** across the relevant indices; resolution of all **145 example references**, **1,097 definition/normalization pairs** and **1,495 diagnostic bindings**; and registration of effective diagnostic codes. These are structural checks alongside targeted semantic review. I did **not** independently reproduce the entire 476-hash/226-blob audit or exhaustively re-audit every field against every source clause. I performed no edits, builds, gameplay or qualification execution.

After recording Codex concurrence, **implementation of this INT-05 module may proceed under the existing owner authorization**. Runtime and final module acceptance remain open. Prior acceptances, explicit genuine-host gaps, representation/I/O limits and TEST_ONLY boundaries remain intact; no workstream, UR, performance, production, whole-engine or Unity closure follows.

**Finish INT-05 through actual final acceptance and accepted push, then stop before any successor.**
